name: Optimize VerFSNext write speed while preserving read/consistency/dedup

description: Use packs.sync_data() instead of sync_all() before commit — reduces fsync from 4 syscalls (2 files × data+meta) to 2 syscalls (data only). sync_data guarantees data + size metadata, and index is rebuildable from pack records on crash via rebuild_index_if_missing.

asi.hypothesis: sync_data is sufficient for crash ordering — pack data on disk before metadata commit. sync_all's metadata flush (timestamps, sizes) is unnecessary since both files are rebuildable from pack records.

description: Remove redundant seek(SeekFrom::End(0)) in pack append — use size_bytes directly which is tracked under lock. Saves one syscall per chunk written.

asi.hypothesis: active.size_bytes under the write lock equals file position at end for O_APPEND files. No need for an extra seek syscall.
